rows.transcript_gb_en_m:
Stand up and stretch your arms up to the sky. Push away any clouds and let the sun shine down on you. Stretch to both sides. Stretch to the front and to the back.

Let your hands hang by your side. Squeeze your shoulders tightly up to your ears as you breathe in, scrunch your eyes, and hold your breath. Release your shoulders as you relax your body.

Relax your arms and let them swing sideways while you turn your upper body. Your arms should gently hit your back as you twist from side to side.

Place one foot in front of the other and make small circles from your ankles – remember to turn to both sides. Do each foot with four circles in each direction.

Now shake your whole body as fast as you can. Shake it up high! Shake it down low! Shake it all around!

Close your eyes and raise your arms slowly above your head as you breathe in. Lower your arms slowly to your side as you breathe out.

Take a moment to reflect on your experience.

Well done! You can do this activity at any time whenever you feel like you need to release stress and energise your mind and body.
rows.transcript_my_ms_m:
Sekarang, sila berdiri dengan selesa.

Berdiri dan regangkan tangan anda tinggi ke atas, seolah‑olah menyentuh langit. Tolak jauh “awan‑awan” yang ada dan bayangkan cahaya matahari menyinari anda. Regangkan ke kiri dan kanan, ke depan dan ke belakang.

Biarkan tangan jatuh di sisi tubuh anda. Angkat bahu anda rapat ke telinga sambil menarik nafas, kerutkan mata anda sedikit, dan tahan sekejap. Lepaskan bahu perlahan‑lahan dan rasa tubuh anda mula tenang.

Longgarkan tangan dan biarkan ia berayun ke kiri dan kanan sambil anda memusingkan badan. Biarkan lengan anda menyentuh belakang dengan lembut setiap kali anda berpusing.

Seterusnya, letakkan satu kaki di hadapan kaki yang lain. Angkat sedikit kaki tersebut dan gerakkan pergelangan kaki membentuk bulatan kecil. Pusing ke arah jam dan lawan arah jam. Ulang empat kali untuk setiap kaki.

[Berhenti seketika selama 5 saat]

Sekarang goncangkan seluruh tubuh anda sekuat yang anda mahu. Goncang ke atas! Goncang ke bawah! Goncang ke semua arah!

Pejamkan mata dan angkat tangan perlahan‑lahan ke atas sambil menarik nafas. Turunkan tangan perlahan‑lahan ke sisi sambil menghembus nafas.

Luangkan masa seketika untuk rasa apa yang berubah dalam tubuh anda.

Syabas! Aktiviti ini anda boleh lakukan pada bila‑bila masa sahaja untuk melepaskan tekanan atau mahu menyegarkan tubuh dan minda.

text_1_facilitator.eng:
3️⃣ Here are three ways to help your child learn number skills: Count, Look for Numbers, and Learn with Shapes. 

Remember: maths, numbers, amounts of things, and shapes are everywhere! 🔶🌷🔵

You can use what is around you and your daily routines to talk to your child about maths. ⏰⭐

section_1_text.eng:
🔴 Counting is a skill your child can start to learn early. 1️⃣2️⃣3️⃣
🚗 Ask your child to count things around you: cars, people, houses, how many steps between one place and another, and their fingers and toes! 👋
🍅 Ask your child to count things in daily activities: like potatoes while cooking, or socks while sorting out clothes.
🎵 Sing songs that include numbers with your child.
🎨 Encourage your child to draw things, or ask them how many things there are in the pictures.

section_2_text.eng:
📱Numbers are all around us if you look for them. They’re on food packaging, and even on the TV remote.
👀 Wherever you see a number, ask your child what it is. 
😃 Help them if they don’t know!

section_3_text.eng:
🔷 your child can also learn through shapes! Shapes are everywhere, too, so find them and talk about them. 👀
🔴 Help your child draw different shapes. 
🔵 If you can, cut them out and help your child sort them into groups (by colour, shape, size, or however else your child wants!) Ask them why they are sorting in that way.
🔶 Talk about the shapes with your child, and have fun with them! 😃
